content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website:drdo.gov.in/ . Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 03-10-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the DRDO ASL recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the DRDO ASL Junior Research Fellow and Research Associate posts is 03-10-2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in this recruitment?
faq.answer: There are a total of 17 vacancies for Junior Research Fellow (JRF) and Research Associate (RA) posts.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for JRF posts?
faq.answer: For JRF posts, candidates need a First Class B.E/B.Tech with a valid GATE Score or ME/M.Tech with first division in relevant disciplines.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification for the RA post?
faq.answer: For the RA post, candidates require a Ph.D in Electronics or ME/M.Tech in Electronics with 3 years of research/teaching experience.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for the DRDO ASL recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all posts is 35 years, with relaxations for SC/ST and OBC categories.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for JRF and RA posts?
faq.answer: JRFs will receive Rs. 37,000/- per month, and RAs will receive Rs. 67,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: There is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve a Written Test followed by an Interview.

faq.question: Q9. In which mode should the application be submitted?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted in Offline mode by sending the application form to the official address mentioned in the notification.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form download links are provided in the Important Links section of this article.
